The '''''Opal''''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. ''Opal'' was seen leaving the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] shortly after the [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|destruction of the ''Scythe'' convoy]] with Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]] on board, bound for the [[Valiant (MC40a light cruiser)|''Valiant'']].
